environment.os: Linux, Docker Engine with Compose and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit
environment.gpu_baseline: Printable Blender processes held about 416 MiB of GPU memory before each run; nothing else used the GPU

recon-worker.PRINTABLE_RECON_DEVICE: cuda, or cpu for the CPU route

measurement.wall_time: request to result; jobs polled every 2 s
measurement.gpu: gpu_peak_allocated_mib from the result; whole-GPU used memory sampled every 0.5 s with nvidia-smi
measurement.ram: photograph worker container cgroup anon, sampled every 0.5 s; memory_current includes file cache
measurement.disk_reads: worker container cgroup io.stat rbytes during the run
measurement.cold: model files dropped from the page cache with posix_fadvise(DONTNEED) before the run, and a photograph not analysed before

criteria.time_under_15_minutes: pass with the local override; slowest 54.1 s (CPU deep analysis)
criteria.default_gpu_analysis_in_published_overla: miss: resource_limit from a 10 GiB cgroup out-of-memory kill, and from Triton loading a module from a /tmp tmpfs without exec
criteria.default_relief_route_vs_marigold_only: pass on surface angle (intervals do not overlap); relief height not distinguishable (intervals overlap)
criteria.relief_hard_checks: pass: 22 of 22 relief STLs had checks.passed true
criteria.photo_object_strict_print_check: miss: 0 of 20 object requests produced a result; every solid rebuild failed
